ja: 彼女、今朝からずっと機嫌が悪いよ。
en: She's been grumpy since this morning.
alternatives: She's been moody since this morning.
She's been cranky since this morning.
point: 「今朝からずっと」は is ではなく has been で表す

ja: 言いにくいんですが、そのデザインはちょっとピンときません。
en: I'm afraid I'm not really sold on that design.
alternatives: I'm afraid that design doesn't really work for me.
I hate to say it, but I'm not sold on that design.
point: I'm afraid / not really で否定意見を柔らかく伝える。

ja: あなたの言葉でどれだけ傷ついたか分からないでしょ。
en: You have no idea how much your words hurt me.
alternatives: You can't imagine how much your words hurt me.
You don't know how badly your words hurt me.
point: how much の後は疑問文の語順にせず、主語＋動詞

ja: 私、今すごく緊張してる。
en: I'm feeling really nervous right now.
alternatives: I'm really nervous right now.
I'm so nervous right now.
point: 「今〜な気分」は feel を進行形にして I'm feeling とできる

ja: 彼女の話を聞いて、私は本当に胸が痛んだ。
en: Hearing her story really pained me.
alternatives: It really hurt to hear her story.
My heart ached when I heard her story.
point: 「聞いて」は Hearing ～ の分詞構文で理由を表せる

ja: 雨なら、家にいたほうがよくない？
en: If it rains, shouldn't we stay home?
alternatives: Shouldn't we stay home if it rains?
Wouldn't staying home be better if it rains?
point: 未来でも if 節は現在形 it rains

ja: 彼女は、待たされるのが大嫌いだと言っていたよ。
en: She said she couldn't stand being kept waiting.
alternatives: She told me she hated being kept waiting.
She said she hated being made to wait.
point: 言った時点に合わせて couldn't。stand の後は動名詞

ja: プロジェクトから外されて、正直がっかり。
en: Honestly, I'm disappointed to be taken off the project.
alternatives: Honestly, I'm bummed they took me off the project.
Honestly, I'm disappointed about being taken off it.
point: 感情の形容詞＋to be＋過去分詞で「〜されて」を表す

ja: 昨日の映画、なぜ気に入らなかったの？
en: Why didn't you like yesterday's movie?
alternatives: Why didn't you enjoy yesterday's movie?
How come you didn't like yesterday's movie?
point: 過去の否定疑問は Why didn't you のあと動詞は原形

ja: もっと貯金していれば、今こんなに焦らないのに。
en: If I'd saved more, I wouldn't be panicking now.
alternatives: I wouldn't be panicking now if I'd saved more.
If I'd saved more, I wouldn't be so stressed now.
point: 過去の仮定→今の結果は If I'd 〜, I wouldn't be 〜ing now

ja: もっと早く言ってくれてれば、手伝えたのに。
en: If you'd told me sooner, I could have helped.
alternatives: I could have helped if you'd told me earlier.
If you'd told me earlier, I'd have helped.
point: 過去の仮定は If + had 過去分詞、主節は could have 過去分詞

ja: この部屋、前よりずっと居心地がいいね。
en: This room feels a lot cozier now.
alternatives: This room is much cozier than before.
This room is way more comfortable now.
point: 「ずっと」は a lot / much で比較級を強める

ja: 母が一番喜んだのは、孫たちからの手紙でした。
en: It was the grandkids' letters that pleased my mother most.
alternatives: What pleased my mother most was the grandkids' letters.
The grandkids' letters were what pleased my mother most.
point: 強調したい部分を It was と that で挟む

ja: 兄は、私が誕生日を覚えていたことに大喜びした。
en: My brother was thrilled I'd remembered his birthday.
alternatives: My brother was so happy I had remembered his birthday.
My brother was delighted that I'd remembered his birthday.
point: 喜んだ時点より前のことなので覚えていたは had + 過去分詞

ja: 新しい仕事にはもう慣れたよ。
en: I've gotten used to my new job.
alternatives: I'm used to my new job now.
I've settled into my new job.
point: 「慣れた」は have gotten used to で現在完了

ja: 正直な意見、聞いてもいいですか？
en: Could I ask your honest opinion?
alternatives: May I ask for your honest opinion?
Could I get your honest opinion?
point: 丁寧な許可は Could I / May I で始める

ja: 上司の言ったこと、正直ちょっと納得いかない。
en: I'm not really convinced by what my boss said.
alternatives: What my boss said doesn't sit well with me.
Honestly, I can't quite accept what my boss said.
point: 「言っていたこと」は what my boss said と名詞節で作る

ja: 宝くじが当たったら、君は仕事辞める？
en: Would you quit if you won the lottery?
alternatives: If you won the lottery, would you quit?
If you hit the jackpot, would you quit?
point: ありえない仮定は if 節を過去形、主節を would にする

ja: 上司に本当のこと言ったほうがいいよ。
en: You should tell your boss the truth.
alternatives: You should be honest with your boss.
I'd tell your boss the truth.
point: 「〜したほうがいい」は should + 動詞の原形

ja: この案、ちょっと問題があると思うな。
en: I think there's a problem with this.
alternatives: There's a problem with this, I think.
I think there's something wrong with this.
point: 「問題がある」は There's a problem with 〜。

ja: 最近よく眠れてなくて、ちょっと参ってる。
en: I haven't been sleeping well. It's wearing me down.
alternatives: I haven't slept well lately. It's wearing me out.
I haven't slept well lately. It's getting to me.
point: 「参ってる」は wear down / wear out で表せる

ja: もっと早く教えてもらえるとありがたいんだけど。
en: I'd appreciate being told earlier.
alternatives: It would be great to be told earlier.
I'd appreciate it if you told me sooner.
It'd be great if you could let me know earlier.
point: appreciate のあとは動名詞。受け身なら being told

ja: 彼がなぜ怒ってるのか、いまいち分からないんだ。
en: I can't quite work out why he's upset.
alternatives: I'm not really sure why he's upset.
I honestly can't tell why he's angry.
point: 間接疑問は why he's upset の語順。疑問文の倒置にしない

ja: 一番がっかりなのは、誰も手伝わなかったこと。
en: What disappointed me most was that nobody helped.
alternatives: Honestly, the worst part was that no one helped.
The most disappointing thing was that nobody helped.
point: 「〜なのは」は what 節、「〜ということ」は that 節で表す

ja: こんなに温かく迎えられるとは、夢にも思わなかった。
en: Never did I imagine such a warm welcome.
alternatives: I never imagined I'd be welcomed so warmly.
I never dreamed of such a warm welcome.
point: Never を文頭に出すと did I imagine の語順になる

ja: 私なら、その申し出を断らなかったな。
en: I wouldn't have turned down that offer.
alternatives: I wouldn't have said no to that offer.
In your shoes, I wouldn't have turned it down.
point: 「私なら」は if 節なしでも wouldn't have 過去分詞

ja: あの電車に乗れていたら、間に合ったのにな。
en: If I'd caught that train, I'd have made it.
alternatives: I'd have made it if I'd caught that train.
Had I caught that train, I'd have made it.
point: make it は「間に合う」。If 節は had caught

ja: その知らせを聞いて、思わず気が滅入ってしまった。
en: Hearing the news, I couldn't help feeling down.
alternatives: I couldn't help feeling down after hearing the news.
I couldn't help but feel down at the news.
point: 「思わず〜してしまう」は couldn't help ～ing

ja: あの頃、もっと正直になればよかった。
en: I wish I'd been more honest back then.
alternatives: If only I'd been more honest back then.
I wish I'd been more upfront back then.
point: 過去への後悔は wish の後を過去完了にする

ja: 彼女にあんなこと言うべきじゃなかった。
en: I shouldn't have said that to her.
alternatives: I never should have said that to her.
I shouldn't have told her that.
point: 過去への後悔は shouldn't have + 過去分詞

ja: 疲れてるけど、この仕事は楽しいよ。
en: Although I'm tired, I enjoy this job.
alternatives: Even though I'm tired, I enjoy this job.
I'm tired, but I still enjoy this job.
point: although の節に but は重ねない。

ja: 今さら予定を変えるのは、気が引けるな。
en: I feel bad about changing plans this late.
alternatives: I'm reluctant to change plans at this point.
I don't feel right changing plans now.
point: feel bad about のあとは動名詞（changing）

ja: いい話があるよ。昇進が決まった。
en: I've got good news. I got promoted.
alternatives: I have good news. I got promoted.
Good news: I got promoted!
point: news は数えられない名詞。a news や newses は不可

ja: この服、派手すぎると思う？
en: Do you think it's too bright?
alternatives: Do you think it's too flashy?
Do you think it's too loud?
point: Do you think の後ろは it's と普通の語順

ja: ここ、好き！また来ようよ。
en: Love it! Let's come back.
alternatives: I love it! Let's come again.
Love this place! Let's come again.
point: 「〜しようよ」は Let's + 動詞の原形

ja: もう終わったから、肩の荷が下りた気分だよ。
en: Now that it's over, I feel like a weight's been lifted.
alternatives: Now that it's all over, it's a weight off my shoulders.
With that over, it feels like a weight has been lifted.
point: 今の気分は現在形、下りた荷は現在完了で言う

ja: 兄に映画を最後まで見させられて、ムッとした。
en: My brother made me finish the movie. Annoying!
alternatives: My brother made me watch the whole movie. Annoying!
My brother made me finish the film. Ugh!
point: 「無理やり〜させる」は make 人 + 動詞の原形

ja: その知らせに、涙をこらえられなかった。
en: I couldn't hold back tears at the news.
alternatives: I couldn't help crying at the news.
I couldn't keep from crying at the news.
point: 「こらえる」は hold back。過去の不可能は couldn't
